title: Landscape of parental postzygotic mutations across >11000 rare disease trios.
journal: American Journal of Human Genetics (AJHG), brief report (PMID 42442367, PMC13504344, open access)

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Downloaded the Europe PMC full-text XML and read its Data and code availability section. Downloaded the Europe PMC supplementaryFiles zip (4.66 MB). It contains only mmc1.pdf (38 pp), mmc2.pdf (article plus supplement, 48 pp) and 4 figure images, with no csv/tsv/xlsx. I extracted the text of both PDFs. Table S1 is a theoretical VAF-by-cell-division model, Table S2 gives spectrum odds ratios (total of 1,015 GEL PZMs), and Table S3 gives ACMG classifications for only 3 variants (VAMP2, DYNC1H1, WT1). NCBI elink for PMID 42442367 found no GEO/SRA/BioProject/dbGaP links (only MedGen/PMC). A Zenodo search by DOI and by title keywords found nothing for this paper. The GitHub/figshare URLs in the PDFs belong to cited third-party tools and studies.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: The figures of 12,015 trios, 14,446,487 unfiltered Mendelian inconsistencies, and 1,015 high-confidence cPZMs across 953 parents. Also the ~5% median parental VAF, the C>A/T>A enrichment and T>C depletion, and the negative GC-content association. None of these could be checked against a file, because the per-variant catalog is not exported.

a1_downloadable.note: Controlled access: Genomics England (100,000 Genomes Project) Research Environment. The paper's data statement says the PZM catalog and code are only inside the GEL RE, at /re_gecip/shared_allGeCIPs/parental_pzm_cat, after an application to join the GEL research network. GEL policy forbids exporting individual-level data, and no open per-variant supplementary table exists (checked).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Not checked because the files are inaccessible. Any label such as 'parental PZM vs DNM vs artefact' would be the output of the authors' multi-step filtering pipeline, not a measured column.

a3_inputs_present.note: Not checked. Per the paper, variants are given as genomic coordinates (GRCh38), which would need reference-sequence extraction. That step is routine.

a4_units_stated.note: Not checked. VAF is a fraction and read counts are integers, per the paper.

a5_enough_rows.note: No file seen. The paper reports 1,015 positive PZMs, which is below the ~1,500 regression threshold but above 400 for classification, plus a pool of 14.4M unfiltered candidates. None of these counts was verified.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: unknown; the catalog itself would be tiny, but the GEL RE is a remote cloud desktop
a6_fits_laptop.note: Data cannot leave the GEL RE, so laptop work is impossible by policy, whatever the size.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Only internal paper consistency checked: 1,015 appears in the abstract, Table S2 and the Figure S7/S15 captions. No download is available to compare against.

a8_label_provenance.note: Flag: 'high-confidence PZM' comes from heuristic filters on parental ALT reads, VAF, depth and recurrence. Training a model on read-level features to predict it would be leakage by construction. No orthogonal (amplicon or single-cell) validation was reported for the GEL calls; the paper's validation is substitution-spectrum concordance with three-generation and twin studies.

existing_models.name: MosaicForecast (Dou et al., Nat Biotechnol 2020, PMC7065972)
existing_models.score_and_split: Per the search summary, 80-90% of mosaic SNVs and 60-80% of indels were validated in brain WGS by single-cell and targeted sequencing; split not checked.

existing_models.name: DeepMosaic (Nat Biotechnol 2022; github.com/XiaoxuYangLab/DeepMosaic)
existing_models.score_and_split: Per the search summary, sensitivity 0.78, specificity 0.83 and PPV 0.96 on non-cancer WGS; trained on 180k simulated or assessed MVs; split not checked.

c2_audit.note: One web search only, and it stopped at the A1 failure. These tools need read-level BAM evidence, which is also locked inside the GEL RE.

backbone.name: Not assessed (a DNA model such as Nucleotide Transformer or AlphaGenome could embed trinucleotide or flanking context if variant coordinates were open)
backbone.licence: Data is GEL controlled access, with no export of individual-level data

integration.partner_dataset: Not assessed (gnomAD / published DNM catalogs such as Kaplanis 2022 would be natural partners)

controls.external_validation: not assessed (Sasani 2019 CEPH and Jonsson 2021 twin PZM sets are the paper's own comparators)

ml_idea: If the data were accessible: classify PZM vs germline DNM from sequence context (trinucleotide, GC, flanking embeddings), a task informative either way. This is moot, because the variant catalog cannot leave the GEL Research Environment.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Already failed. The Data and code availability statement restricts the catalog to the GEL RE, and the open supplement holds only PDFs with aggregate tables plus 3 named variants.

verdict_reason: A1 fails. The 1,015-PZM catalog and code are only inside the Genomics England Research Environment (controlled access, application required, no export of individual-level data). The open supplement is PDF-only, with aggregate Tables S1-S2 and just 3 variants in S3. No open mirror exists on NCBI or Zenodo.
